mapper.insert: INSERT INTO investment_transaction (user_id, account_id, holding_id, txn_type, symbol, market, trade_date, quantity, price, amount, fee, currency, cny_rate, amount_cny, is_synthetic, note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{accountId}, #{holdingId}, #{txnType}, #{symbol}, #{market}, #{tradeDate}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{amount}, #{fee}, #{currency}, #{cnyRate}, #{amountCny}, #{isSynthetic}, #{note})
mapper.update: UPDATE investment_transaction SET symbol = #{symbol}, market = #{market}, trade_date = #{tradeDate}, quantity = #{quantity}, price = #{price}, amount = #{amount}, fee = #{fee}, currency = #{currency}, cny_rate = #{cnyRate}, amount_cny = #{amountCny}, note = #{note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM investment_transaction WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN txn_type = 'CASH_IN' THEN amount_cny WHEN txn_type = 'CASH_OUT' THEN -amount_cny ELSE 0 END ), 0) FROM investment_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND trade_date = #{date}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM investment_transaction WHERE holding_id = #{holdingId} AND txn_type = 'OPENING'
